image_description: A rear-view shot of a large white pelican standing on a rocky surface near water. The bird's head is turned away, showing the back of its neck and upper back. The wings are folded against the body, displaying white plumage with some textural detail. The legs are visible, appearing thin and orange/brown, standing on mossy rocks. The background consists of dark water with light reflections.

The neck is visible and shows a curvature consistent with a resting pelican, though the full 'S' shape is hard to trace perfectly from this angle.
The tail feathers are visible at the rear, appearing short and tucked, consistent with the description.

The right leg seems disproportionately thin compared to the massive body, and the connection to the body is hidden by feathers, creating a slight 'floating' or disconnected appearance.
